paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC percentage for various editing methods on BioMedLM. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from approximately 1 to 5000, and has tick labels at irregular intervals. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 40 to 65, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. There are six lines in the plot: Base (black, solid line with circular markers) starts at around 39 and ends at around 43; FT (blue, solid line with triangular markers) starts at around 40 and ends at around 47; IKE (red, solid line with triangular markers) starts at around 42 and ends at around 50; MEND (brown, solid line with circular markers) starts at around 43 and ends at around 56; MEMIT (purple, solid line with triangular markers) starts at around 44 and ends at around 54; ROME (green, solid line with triangular markers) starts at around 48 and ends at around 65.
